name: 1N4733A
source: onsemi 1N4728A Series データシート (1N4728A/D Rev. 2, 2002-01) と Vishay 1N4728A〜1N4761A データシート (Document Number 85816, Rev. 2.7, 2024-11)
description: 1N4733A ツェナーダイオード 5.1V 1W (DO-41、帯の側がカソード K)。逆方向で定電圧を作る。データシート (onsemi・Vishay) の代表特性から作った等価モデル

forward.at: Vishay の図 2 (順方向の代表特性) の 25 °C

breakdown.note: ツェナーの欄から (表の逆電流の max は 1 V で 10 µA)

capacitance.at: onsemi の図 9 (容量とツェナー電圧の代表特性) の 0 V・1 V・降伏の 50 % のバイアス

no_recovery: 逆回復時間は扱いません (ツェナーのデータシートに trr は無い)。

zener.at: onsemi の図 7 (動抵抗とツェナー電圧の代表特性、25 °C、60 Hz)
zener.leak_at: onsemi の図 8 (公称の 80 % の電圧の代表値)
zener.tc: 表には無い。onsemi の図 4 では 1 mA で約 +0.6、20 mA で約 +1.1 mV/°C (5.1 V あたりは電流で符号が変わる境目)

remarks: two makers' sheets: onsemi's (1N4728A/D Rev. 2; onsemi no longer hosts it, the copy is from pccomponents.com) has the typical breakdown curves (figures 7 to 9), Vishay's (85816) the typical forward curve (figure 2) and Zzt typ. Both list the same nominal voltage, test current and maxima
forward, hot: Vishay figure 2, the 25 C and 150 C curves (colored), read with `ds trace ... rows` at 3 uA to 30 mA (the same for the three parts; the figure is for the series)

zener.zz: onsemi figure 7 (Zz against Vz at IZ = 1, 5, 20 mA), read at 5.1 V with `ds trace xt= yt=` (the labels are pictures; the ticks from `ds grid`: Vz 1/10/100 at 333.4/440.9/546.6 pt, Zz 1/10/100/1000 at 195.2/148.6/101.6/55.0 pt)

the model's NBV is fitted to the rise of the zener voltage from 1 to 20 mA (the readings integrated as power laws), so that the voltage across a range of current is right; the dynamic resistance at single currents is compared
zener.leak: onsemi figure 8 (typical leakage at 80 % of the nominal voltage), the 25 C curve: compared only
capacitance: onsemi figure 9 (0 V, 1 V and 50 % of breakdown bias)
tc: onsemi figures 2 and 4 (not in the model: the simulator's BV does not change with temperature)
